business_problem: UnionPay Merchant Services needed to move away from traditional IT infrastructure so it could support large numbers of merchants more flexibly, offer cloud-based services safely, and create a stronger technical base for intelligent merchant applications.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud first helped UnionPay Merchant Services migrate from traditional infrastructure to a distributed private cloud, then extended that foundation into a financial-grade public cloud for merchants. The architecture combines IaaS and PaaS services with industry knowledge from UnionPay's payment business so the company can offer secure infrastructure, system migration support, and future SaaS capabilities to small and large merchants alike. The same platform is designed to support microservices and DevOps for a one-stop technical middle platform, while downstream scenarios can incorporate AI and map services for merchant operations such as traffic analysis, in-mall visualization, cloud backup, and smart retail functions. Instead of only using the cloud internally, UnionPay Merchant Services uses the shared financial cloud as a service layer that lets customers move their supply-chain, finance, ecommerce, and other systems onto regulated infrastructure without building it themselves.

solution_components.name: Financial-grade Public Cloud
solution_components.role: Extends the cloud foundation into a merchant-facing regulated service offering for external customers.

solution_components.name: IaaS and PaaS Service Stack
solution_components.role: Supplies secure infrastructure and platform services for merchant system migration and operations.

solution_components.name: Financial Cloud Service
solution_components.role: Packages infrastructure, migration, and future SaaS enablement into a reusable merchant cloud offering.

data_flow: UnionPay Merchant Services first moves internal and merchant workloads from traditional environments into the distributed private cloud, then exposes infrastructure and platform services through the financial-grade public cloud. Merchant business systems such as supply-chain, finance, ecommerce, and mall-operations applications run on that cloud and can be extended with AI and map services for downstream digital experiences.
business_outcome: UnionPay Merchant Services built a merchant-facing financial cloud that lowers customer infrastructure burden, improves scalability, and creates a path for AI- and map-enabled merchant services across its payment ecosystem.
metrics: The platform is intended to support more than 8 million merchants.
The merchant financial cloud formally went live in August 2018 and is already serving hundreds of merchants.
architecture_clues: The solution evolved from an internal private-cloud migration into an external merchant financial-cloud service.
The target architecture includes microservices and DevOps as the basis for a broader technical middle platform.
AI and map services are positioned as downstream merchant enablement capabilities rather than core payment-processing features.
evidence_quotes: UnionPay Merchant Services and Baidu jointly built a financial-grade cloud service for more than 8 million merchants (original: 银联商务与百度智能云共建金融级云服务…不断帮助银联商务800多万家合作商户增强自身核心竞争力).
Baidu first helped UnionPay move from traditional IT architecture to a cloud platform based entirely on distributed architecture (original: 百度智能云帮助银联商务从传统的IT架构迁移到云平台上。该云平台是一套完全基于分布式架构的私有云系统).

The merchant financial cloud relies on Baidu's IaaS and PaaS layers and can support merchant system migration and future SaaS services (original: 依托百度智能云的IaaS、PaaS层…提供安全可靠的IT基础设施和系统上云整体解决方案…打造"支付+云"模式).
The financial cloud officially went live in August 2018 and is serving hundreds of merchants (original: 银联商务与百度智能云共建的金融云于2018年8月正式投产上线，目前正在服务几百家商户).
